feature: Extract duplicated CRUD state management into reusable hooks
workflow_rationale: This is a refactoring task that extracts duplicated state management patterns from 19+ CRUD pages into reusable custom hooks. The pattern follows: Add new hooks → Migrate pages to use hooks → Verify no breaking changes → Remove old patterns.

phases.name: Add New Hooks
phases.description: Create new reusable custom hooks alongside existing code without modifying any pages

subtasks.description: Create useCrudState hook for loading/error/saving state management

verification.command: npm run build 2>&1 | grep -q 'Compiled successfully' && echo 'OK' || echo 'FAIL'

subtasks.notes: Created useCrudState hook with TypeScript interfaces, JSDoc documentation, and comprehensive state management for isLoading, error, isSaving, and isDeleting states. Also includes clearError and reset utility actions. Build verification passed successfully.

subtasks.description: Create useModalState hook for modal and form state management

verification.command: npm run build 2>&1 | grep -q 'Compiled successfully' && echo 'OK' || echo 'FAIL'

subtasks.notes: Created useModalState hook with comprehensive TypeScript interfaces, JSDoc documentation, and state management for isModalOpen, editingItem, isSaving, formData, formError, deleteTarget, and isDeleting states. Includes actions for opening create/edit modals, closing modals, managing form data, and handling delete confirmations. Follows patterns from useTableContext.ts and categories/page.tsx. Committed successfully.

subtasks.description: Create useDeleteConfirmation hook for delete confirmation dialogs

verification.command: npm run build 2>&1 | grep -q 'Compiled successfully' && echo 'OK' || echo 'FAIL'

subtasks.notes: Created useDeleteConfirmation hook with TypeScript interfaces, JSDoc documentation, and comprehensive state management for deleteTarget and isDeleting states. Includes actions for opening/closing delete confirmation dialog and a convenience handleDelete wrapper for automatic state management. Follows patterns from products/page.tsx and organizations/page.tsx. Build verification passed successfully. Committed successfully.

subtasks.description: Create useCrudOperations hook that combines all CRUD hooks

verification.command: npm run build 2>&1 | grep -q 'Compiled successfully' && echo 'OK' || echo 'FAIL'

subtasks.notes: Created useCrudOperations hook that combines useCrudState, useModalState, and useDeleteConfirmation into a single comprehensive interface. Also created hooks/index.ts to export all hooks with proper TypeScript type exports. The composite hook provides a complete CRUD state management solution through three namespaced properties: crudState (page-level states), modalState (modal/form operations), and deleteConfirmation (standalone delete dialogs). Includes comprehensive JSDoc documentation with real-world usage examples. Build verification passed successfully. Committed successfully.

subtasks.notes: Successfully migrated categories page to use useCrudOperations hook. Replaced individual state management with centralized CRUD hooks for modal, form, and delete operations. All functionality preserved including hierarchical category tree structure.

subtasks.description: Migrate tables page to use new CRUD hooks
subtasks.notes: Successfully migrated tables page to use useCrudOperations hook. Replaced individual state management (isLoading, error, isModalOpen, editingTable, isSaving, formData, formError, deleteTarget, isDeleting) with centralized CRUD hooks through crudState, modalState, and deleteConfirmation. All functionality preserved including QR code generation, bulk downloads, status changes, and table management. Reduced ~20 lines of state declarations while improving code maintainability and consistency.
